# Kitty frame presenter

Runtime source from
[kitty-frame-presenter](https://github.com/itsmygithubacct/kitty-frame-presenter),
pinned by `upstream.json`. Listed files are unmodified committed source with
SHA-256 digests. The MIT license is included.

Used by Batty's bundled Kilix application provider for bounded shared-memory
frames, damage updates and overwrite composition. No installation or network
fetch is required at runtime for this package.
